dal-plan-review.form_seen: Food establishment permit and plan review (Consumer Health; Planning & Development for new construction)

attach.en: Facility blueprints and equipment specification sheets

destination.evidence: For new construction, change in ownership, remodels or a change of use, contact Planning & Development at 320 E. Jefferson Blvd. or 214-670-4127. A separate plan review application (CCS-FRM-352, $205) applies only to kiosks and self-service establishments, at 7901 Goforth.

dal-plan-review.notes: Dallas plan review for a fixed restaurant runs through the building permit in DallasNow (Planning & Development), not a health form. Annual food permit fees: risk 1 $141-$155, risk 2 $283-$308, risk 3 $468-$513; due Dec 31.

aus-co.form_seen: Certificate of Occupancy (issued after final inspection)

destination.evidence: A CO is provided upon a successful final inspection for new construction or significant renovations; if one was not issued, email DSDCertificateofOccupancy@austintexas.gov.

aus-co.notes: No standalone change-of-use form on the page; the CO follows the building permit's final inspection. Temporary CO requests use a JotForm web form, with fees added to the project's trade permits. The change-of-use submittal PDF could not be read.
